description: Source code for an Android TV frontend app, defining the HomeActivity and composable UI components for the home screen, including header, hero banner, sections with posters and TV channel cards, with focus and accessibility features.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: Main activity hosting the home screen, sets the Compose content.

methods.name: HomeScreen
methods.description: Composable function rendering the main home screen layout with header, hero banner, sections.

methods.name: HeaderBar
methods.description: Composable for the top navigation header with logo, nav buttons, search, and avatar.

methods.name: SearchIconGroup
methods.description: Composable rendering layered SVG images for search icon.

methods.name: FocusablePillText
methods.description: Composable for focusable text pills used in navigation.

methods.name: LogoGroup
methods.description: Composable assembling small SVG glyphs into a logo.

methods.name: SvgImage
methods.description: Wrapper composable for displaying SVG images.

methods.name: SvgOrImage
methods.description: Loads either SVG or PNG images using AsyncImage.

methods.name: TvChannelCard
methods.description: Composable representing a TV channel card with image, overlay, play button, and info.
